note: Generated by npm run sprites:export from src/content/sprites.ts. Every sprite is drawn in code; a file here replaces one only when its slot is enabled there. Missing or broken files fall back to the generated sprite.
transparency: PNG with a transparent background (alpha 0), no anti-aliasing against a colour; hard pixel edges.
scaling: Drawn at whole-number scales with image-rendering: pixelated. width/height are one frame in art pixels; trainer poses may be drawn at a whole multiple (e.g. 160×240) for finer detail. The overworld sheet must be exactly 48×64 per frame.

aaryan.front.use: Aaryan standing (idle pose): main menu, Profile, Battle hub, Champion opponent
aaryan.front.layout: single frame, feet on the bottom row, body centred

aaryan.vs.use: VS screen (pointing pose, cropped to a bust by the band)
aaryan.vs.layout: single frame; keep the head and chest in the top half
aaryan.vs.facing: towards the viewer, pointing to the right (mirrored when Aaryan is the opponent)

aaryan.victory.use: Victory pose: Aaryan as Champion after winning a battle

aaryan.portrait.use: Trainer Card ID photo and message headers

aaryan.overworld.use: Aaryan walking on the map (Medal Box room, Champion floor)
aaryan.overworld.layout: one row of 12 frames at exactly 48×64 each: down, up, left, right × (stand, step A, step B)
